answer: Tie each identity to a bond held in a communal vault plus continuous proof of useful work: to join, an agent locks a deposit and must keep solving small puzzles seeded by a public beacon, with its reputation ebbing like a tide unless fresh verified work renews it. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand locked deposits and a thousand streams of compute, and any identity caught lying loses its bond, so fakes cost real money and upkeep while one honest agent pays a single deposit.
